newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Feb 5.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Feb. 5:

WASHINGTON - President Clinton declared that "the enemy of our time is inaction", and pledged in his second term to lead Washington to bipartisan agreements on balancing the budget and enacting campaign finance reform and to lead a "national crusade" to improve education.

WASHINGTON - In his State of the Union address a year ago, President Clinton had one overriding objective -- to salvage his presidency and win re-election. This time he faced a different challenge -- to define the murky "vital center" that has become his political home.
BELGRADE - President Slobodan Milosevic announced he is willing to acknowledge opposition victories in Belgrade and 13 other Yugoslav cities.

WASHINGTON - Army Chief of Staff Gen. Dennis Reumer said for the first time that he believes the service should re-examine whether the benefits of joint military training of men and women, which he supports, outweigh the drawbacks.
WASHINGTON - An enduring mystery in the history of crime -- the 1954 Sam Sheppard murder case that inspired the TV series "The Fugitive" -- may have been resolved through DNA testing.
